title: The ordinary-double-point volume gap

result.label: The ordinary-double-point volume gap
result.statement: Proves the ordinary-double-point volume-gap conjecture: every singular complex algebraic klt germ of dimension n ≥ 2, with zero boundary, has normalized volume at most 2(n-1)^n. Equality holds precisely for an analytic ordinary double point.
